text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki's training was progressing 
smoothly towards the Mainichi Hai.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...! What's the time...?
choice_data_list: You've closed the gap since yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Alright!
choice_data_list: One more run, focus on your lap times.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes.

Yaeno Muteki turned around and froze in 
her tracks. What caught her gaze was—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Kh... my legs feel so heavy... I really do 
lack the power...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...I need to add more muscle training. 
Let's see, when running uphill... I get 
it, maybe my abs and back are too weak...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"And then... when climbing while moving 
laterally, I wonder if the acceleration 
changes depending on which direction you 
kick off from...?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
All right! Next one's diagonally, let's do 
another rep!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O-san—
choice_data_list: She's really fired up, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. She was lamenting that her run in the 
last race left a lot to be desired... She 
must be working on measures to fix that.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Look back at the race to identify areas 
for improvement, then reflect that in our 
training.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Additionally, during training, we examine 
any issues after each run and make them 
our next focus.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Instead of just blindly churning out reps, 
she reflects after every run, sets a goal, 
and tackles the next one.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Facing one's own flaws and resolving them. 
Chiyono O-san is someone capable of 
repeating that process.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That is no ordinary strength of will.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
From my experience in martial arts, steady 
and diligent accumulation will always lead 
to immense growth eventually...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Formidable indeed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, just visualizing it really makes it 
tough to get a grasp on the timing to make 
a move...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hii, Chiyo-chan♪ What's the matter? Are 
you having trouble with something?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-san! Ah, um... no, never mind, 
it's nothing!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Geez, that's why I can't just leave you 
alone~ You're kinda like me in a way.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, are you looking for a training 
partner? I can run with you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh!? How did you know?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, during your last race, you stayed 
at the back and had a really hard time 
moving forward, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Knowing Chiyo-chan, I thought maybe she'd 
have prepared a countermeasure for that!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, exactly...! But... are you really 
sure about running alongside me...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Abso-tootly-lutely! After all, she took my 
entrusted feelings to heart and is doing 
her absolute best...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I at least want to help out, don't you 
think?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you so much! I'll be in your 
care!!

It looks like Sakura Chiyono O will be 
running alongside Maruzensky, the 
Umamusume famously known as the 
"Supercar."

Running alongside her, with all her 
experience in the Twinkle Series, is sure 
to teach you a lot.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Knowing how caring Maruzen-san is, 
Chiyono O will surely realize her own 
weaknesses from running alongside her.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And Chiyono O will overcome her weaknesses 
and become stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
There is no time to dally! Here comes a 
match!

"After finishing training on the track and 
heading to the gym, I saw a familiar 
face."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—...Phew... This is as far as I go, isn't 
it...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Ardan-san, are you alright? You don't 
look very well..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Yaeno-san. There is no need to worry. 
Please, don't mind me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
If there were any issue, I wouldn't be 
catching my breath like this.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If that is the case, then that is fine, 
but...

It was only natural for Yaeno Muteki to 
worry. Mejiro Ardan's body was frail, 
having experienced repeated 
hospitalizations and discharges.

Because of that, I heard that despite 
entering her growth spurt as an Umamusume 
quite some time ago, she has continued to 
put off her debut.

If you put too much strain on your body, 
you could easily end up hospitalized 
again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I want to keep building up my 
training, even if it is just bit by bit."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
If I just sit around peacefully, I'll 
never catch up to Yaeno and the others.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You did mention that you would definitely 
make your debut this year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Since reaching my peak blooming 
period, I have squandered far too much 
time...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Compared to the other girls, I likely have 
very little time left.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I must do everything in my 
power to make my debut this year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Rather than withering away having achieved 
nothing, I want to shine upon the turf, 
even if only for a fleeting moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Everything was a choice made with firm 
resolve. Please, do not worry about me.

With that firm declaration, Mejiro Ardan 
returned to her training.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...What incredible resolve...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I could feel her sheer determination to 
run, even at the risk of her own life.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —However, I can't afford to lose either.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I must master "Unity of Fire and Water" 
and make my victory absolute!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Trainer-dono, I request your assistance!

Her two rivals light a fire in Yaeno 
Muteki. Deep in her eyes, a blazing flame 
is unmistakably visible—
